_about: Deliberate external links that are not shopping links, so `npm run links:audit` does not report them. Each entry needs a host or a url (exact, or a prefix ending in *), optionally a page path prefix, and a reason. Never add a store or brand product link here: link a store that pays us, or name the product without a link.
